research.objective: Using validation-only evidence, produce bounded research and risk directives for the frozen Phase 12 protocol. Never access test metrics.
research.rationale: Static research fallback schedules no tools or experiments.

risk_proposed.rationale: Given current drawdown of 8% and heightened volatility (z-score 1.0), we impose conservative limits to preserve capital. Risk budget is set to 10% annualized volatility, max asset weight caps single asset exposure at 5%, cash floor ensures 20% liquidity buffer, max turnover limits rebalancing costs to 15% per period, and monthly rebalancing reduces trading frequency. Allow new positions with strict adherence to these limits.
